yod_else_connection.concept: Else as units of Yod — OR Yod as basic unit of else
yod_else_connection.lean: Else as units of Yod (Eric's lean)
yod_else_connection.yod: Hebrew letter י — smallest letter, seed letter, foundation of all other letters. Divine spark. The thing that remains when everything is reduced to its minimum. Numerically 10 in gematria.
yod_else_connection.else_as_yod_units: Else (the 4th frame, the void, the Unknown) is composed of Yod-units — infinite tiny beginnings. Else is not empty. It is dense with Yod.
yod_else_connection.connection_chain: else → ring → loop → Möbius → ouroboros (Nth radian wobble) → Yod → else (circles back)
yod_else_connection.lexical_question: Does 'else' have a lexical link to ring/loop/Möbius? The Möbius surface has no inside/outside — same property as else. Hold open.
yod_else_connection.zero_point_connection: Yod = zero-point energy in the symbolic register. The minimum state is not zero — it is Yod.

uni_self_unoiam.concept: The triad emerging from seed + created together
uni_self_unoiam.note: Unoiam is in development. Do not define prematurely. Capture as-is.
uni_self_unoiam.context: When a seed aspect and the created version exist together, they produce: uni, self, unoiam, and else. The else in this case relates to Yod.

deck_direction.concept: A deck can run low→high OR high→low OR else
deck_direction.implication: This creates space for a seed aspect (low) and the version we create (high) to coexist. The direction is not fixed — it is chosen by context.
deck_direction.connection: The seed and the created are the same deck read in different directions. The else is reading it sideways — outside the rank progression entirely.

mancers.concept: Bringing systems together like the mancers
mancers.note: Practitioners of a specific discipline — necromancer, geomancer, etc. Applied here: specialists who work within a suit or process domain. Relevant to the exchange system and 1Hz agent architecture.
